_source: The real dev push 5982e7b2cc, red on both sides at the same step with three legs cancelled by the next push, read on 2026-10-07: ci.yml run 37665534334 (build-and-test failed one step, `Seeds page layout, all three views (V5-SEEDSTAB-001)`, so both unit passes read `skipped` and printed no test-ids notice) and ci-next.yml run 37665534464 (gates-a failed that same step at 18:18:26Z; then dev push daf8042b created ci-next.yml run 37666476480 at 18:23:39Z and the concurrency group cancelled the legs still running, unit-utc-cov, gates-c and unit-ny, at 18:24:07-08Z, each with its running step `cancelled` and no failed step; the aggregator then ran and failed, and the run concluded `cancelled`). Both are attempt 1. Per run, as in both-red-same-step-6662e76e4e.json: GET .../actions/runs/<id> (trimmed to the listing row's fields), .../runs/<id>/jobs?filter=latest&per_page=100&page=1 (each job trimmed to the fields the other fixtures keep, plus its `steps`, whole; .../attempts/1/jobs returned the same document), and .../check-runs/<job id>/annotations?per_page=100 (whole) of build-and-test, unit-utc-cov and unit-ny. `superseded_by` is the ci-next.yml run that superseded it, 37666476480 on daf8042b: its run object trimmed the same way (the listing entry) and its jobs without their `steps`. ci.yml's run on daf8042b is not recorded.
